name: Yuexiu Services Group Limited
summary: Yuexiu Services Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides property management services in Mainland China and Hong Kong. The company operates in two segments: Non-Commercial Property Management and Value-Added Services; and Commercial Property Management and Operational Services. It offers cleaning, security, gardening, and repair and maintenance services to property owners, property owners' associations and/or residents, and property developers.
